simulations.title: Post-Viral Syndrome Outbreak
simulations.description: Agent-based population simulation tracking viral outbreak and post-viral ME/CFS conversion across 100 individuals. 25+ calibrated risk factors, brainstem ANS dynamics, YOU character.

simulations.title: Emergence / Flocking
simulations.description: Each agent follows three simple local rules — avoid, align, cohere. No agent sees the global pattern. The flock emerges from purely local interactions.

simulations.title: Feedback Loops
simulations.description: Reinforcing loops amplify change. Balancing loops resist change and seek equilibrium. Most complex systems are networks of both.

simulations.title: Lorenz Attractor
simulations.description: Three linked differential equations produce a trajectory that never repeats yet stays bounded. Tiny differences in starting position lead to completely different futures.

simulations.title: Network Diffusion
simulations.description: A contagion spreads through a small-world network. Hubs drive early cascades; local clusters slow saturation. Network topology — not transmission rate alone — determines the shape of spread.

simulations.title: Backroom Dynamics
simulations.description: Two networks overlay the same population: the formal hierarchy and the informal relationship layer. A decision cascades through both — the informal network redistributes influence in ways the org chart cannot predict.

blank_sub: Each simulation demonstrates a structural concept in systems science. Use the sliders to explore parameter space and observe how the architecture of the system — not just its components — determines behavior.
